verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe scheduling recurring runs (morning PR reviews, overnight CI analysis, weekly audits), background/remote execution via mobile/web with teleport, chat-triggered automation (Slack @Claude), and SDK for building custom autonomous agents — directly supporting background automation setups. Community evidence doesn't dispute this specific capability, though general reliability concerns (comm-16,17,19,20) suggest caveats on trustworthiness of unattended runs.
